prompt:
Write a portfolio case study in Markdown for the freelancer Tobias Reyne (Full-stack developer - React, Next.js, Node.js and Postgres).

Project facts (the only truth you may use):
title: Tutor marketplace MVP
client: Brightpath Tutors
client_industry: edtech
start: 2021-10
end: 2022-02
engagement: fixed
stack:
- Next.js
- Node.js
- MongoDB
- Stripe Connect
- Twilio Video
implied_skills:
- marketplace payouts
built: A two-sided marketplace with tutor profiles, booking, video lessons and automatic
  tutor payouts.
metrics:
- live in 11 weeks
- 300 tutors
- $48k gross bookings in the first quarter

Requirements:
- 300 to 450 words, first person, a short title line starting with "# ".
- Loosely cover the client's problem, what was built, and the results. Emphasis: the technical approach.
- Include one short code or config snippet (5 to 15 lines) in a fenced block that fits the stack.
- Refer to the client as "Brightpath Tutors".
- Never use these words or phrases: "marketplace payouts". Describe the work so a reader can infer them.
